# CBS News
> CBS News delivers breaking news, live updates, and in-depth reporting across U.S., world, politics, business, health, crime, entertainment, and science.

CBS News is a national news publisher covering major headlines, investigations, analysis, and live events. Its site organizes reporting into topical news desks, local market pages, live blogs, video programming, and special franchises including MoneyWatch and HealthWatch.

## Main News Sections
- [Home](https://www.cbsnews.com/): Front page for breaking news, top stories, featured video, and major live coverage.
- [U.S.](https://www.cbsnews.com/us/): National news coverage including courts, disasters, education, immigration, and public safety.
- [World](https://www.cbsnews.com/world/): International reporting on conflicts, diplomacy, disasters, and global affairs.
- [Politics](https://www.cbsnews.com/politics/): Coverage of elections, Congress, the White House, policy, and campaigns.
- [Crime](https://www.cbsnews.com/crime/): Reporting on criminal investigations, trials, policing, and justice system developments.
- [Entertainment](https://www.cbsnews.com/entertainment/): News on film, television, music, celebrities, and cultural events.
- [Space](https://www.cbsnews.com/space/): Coverage of launches, NASA missions, astronomy, and commercial spaceflight.

## Business and Health
- [MoneyWatch](https://www.cbsnews.com/moneywatch/): Business, personal finance, markets, housing, jobs, and consumer news.
- [HealthWatch](https://www.cbsnews.com/healthwatch/): Health reporting on medicine, public health, wellness, and medical research.
- [Brand Studio](https://www.cbsnews.com/brandstudio/): Sponsored content and branded editorial features published by CBS News Brand Studio.
- [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/): Sports news, scores, analysis, and live coverage from CBS Sports.
- [The Free Press](https://www.thefp.com/?utm_source=cbsnews&utm_medium=global_nav): External partner publication linked from CBS News global navigation.

## Live Coverage
- [Live Updates](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/): Index of CBS News live blogs covering breaking and developing stories.
- [Iran Latest](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-strait-of-hormuz-oil-tanker-israel/): Live updates on Iran-related developments, regional tensions, and energy market impacts.
- [DHS Shutdown](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/dhs-shutdown-2026-senate-funding-day-42/): Live blog tracking the federal funding standoff and Department of Homeland Security shutdown.
- [CBS News 24/7](https://www.cbsnews.com/live/): Live streaming news video and continuous CBS News coverage.
- [Video](https://www.cbsnews.com/video/): Video hub for clips, interviews, segments, and full news reports.

## Shows and Programs
- [CBS Evening News](https://www.cbsnews.com/evening-news/): Coverage, segments, and reporting from the flagship nightly newscast.
- [CBS Mornings](https://www.cbsnews.com/cbs-mornings/): Stories, interviews, and features from the morning news program.
- [Face the Nation](https://www.cbsnews.com/face-the-nation/): Sunday public affairs program with interviews and political analysis.
- [60 Minutes](https://www.cbsnews.com/60-minutes/): Investigative reporting, interviews, and segments from the long-running newsmagazine.
- [48 Hours](https://www.cbsnews.com/48-hours/): True crime reporting, case coverage, and documentary-style investigations.
- [Sunday Morning](https://www.cbsnews.com/sunday-morning/): Arts, culture, profiles, and feature reporting from CBS News Sunday Morning.

## Local News
- [Local News](https://www.cbsnews.com/cbslocal/): Directory for CBS local stations and regional news coverage.
- [Atlanta](https://www.cbsnews.com/atlanta/): Local news, weather, and community coverage for the Atlanta area.
- [Baltimore](https://www.cbsnews.com/baltimore/): Baltimore-area local reporting, weather, and regional headlines.
- [Bay Area](https://www.cbsnews.com/sanfrancisco/): San Francisco Bay Area news, weather, and local investigations.
- [Boston](https://www.cbsnews.com/boston/): Boston local news, New England coverage, and weather updates.
- [Chicago](https://www.cbsnews.com/chicago/): Chicago-area reporting on local government, crime, weather, and events.

## Topic and Story Formats
- [Latest](https://www.cbsnews.com/): Continuously updated homepage stream of the newest CBS News stories.
- [News](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/): Article archive and general news index across CBS News reporting.
- [Investigations](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/): In-depth reporting and enterprise journalism published within the news archive.
- [Photos](https://www.cbsnews.com/pictures/): Photo galleries documenting major news events, features, and visual explainers.
- [Podcasts](https://www.cbsnews.com/podcasts/): Audio programming and podcast episodes from CBS News brands.
- [Latest Videos](https://www.cbsnews.com/latest-videos/): Recently published video clips and on-demand news segments.

- [Newsletters](https://www.cbsnews.com/newsletters/): Email newsletter signup pages for CBS News topics and programs.
- [Sitemap](https://www.cbsnews.com/sitemap/): Structured index of CBS News sections, topics, and content pages.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.cbsnews.com/privacy/): Privacy practices and data handling information for CBS News users.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.cbsnews.com/terms-of-use/): Terms governing access to and use of CBS News websites and services.
